flows: Navigate directly to the agreement and clauses

agentReliability.reason: Stagehand semantic QA omitted under the user-approved local workflow; deterministic Playwright behaviors remain required.

acceptanceCriteria: Every included route renders without console errors, failed critical network requests, or broken navigation.
Every included route has stable landmarks, headings, accessible names, visible focus, and readable responsive layout evidence.
Primary actions, empty states, loading states, error states, success states, and disabled states are visually clear and have tight product copy.
Reusable components listed in agentic-ui/component-state-matrix.json have matching state coverage evidence.
No POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, upload, approval, submission, billing, auth, or destructive action runs during non-mutating QA.
knownTradeoffs: Parameterized routes require explicit seed data or safe-flow definitions before QA can exercise them.
Mutating workflows require approved sandbox mutation mode and are not covered by non-mutating broad audit.
Stitch, Magic, Stagehand and Browserbase are omitted under docs/local-workflow.md; no hosted or semantic certification claim.
